当前官网与HF卡在题量、worlds、私有/开放策略及主指标上不同；数据卡同时标: The current official website and the HF card differ in the number of questions, in worlds, in the private or open policy, and in the main metric; the data card marks both CC-BY-4.0 and a prohibition on training, on fitting of parameters, and on automatic scraping, those additional terms must be checked, and the card must not be reduced to openness without conditions.
官网当前可读29行模型，方法摘要的25模型指首发论文。±为按题聚类bootstr: 29 rows of models can currently be read on the official website, and the 25 models in the summary of the method refer to the paper at first release. The ± is the half-width of a 95% interval from a bootstrap clustered by question, not a standard deviation and not the standard error of three repeats. The current leaderboard on the official website and the results from the first release of the paper cannot be presented as an experiment from the same day.
导读来源：[官方材料](https://www.vals.ai/benchmar: Guide source: [Official materials](https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/robo_bench) (accessed 2026-11-08); specific facts and historical access dates are given in the individual fields.
2024年论文v5为3,217题；仓库README正文仍为2,974题，下载表d: Paper v5 of 2024 has 3,217 questions; the body of the repository README is still at 2,974 questions, and the download table lists dev 1,164 and test 1,784, which also do not add up to 2,974. Each basis is retained, and a single number of questions is not guessed at.

This is cleaning that is recorded by version, and it does not mean that the data are free of error.
原论文所有作者的唯一署名单位为Allen Institute for Artif: The only affiliation named for every author of the original paper is the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence; this field records the institution that is named in public, and a legal collaboration that is not listed is not inferred from it.
公开10项目rli-public-set数据卡明确Apache 2.0。未把该许: The data card for the 10 public projects, rli-public-set, states Apache 2.0 explicitly. That license is not extended to the 230 private projects or to the software of the review platform; the usual LICENSE path on the platform returns 404, and the license of the code remains Unverified.
官方版本日志：初次数据发布v1为2020-10-28；ChemRxiv页面版本日: The official version log: the first release of the data, v1, is dated 2020-10-28; the version date on the ChemRxiv page is 2020-10-29. Formal publication in Matter is in 2021, and 2021 cannot be mistaken for the year in which the database was first released.
官方榜单由论文人工整理，官方提醒可能有错误、歧义和缺失；zero-shot/fe: The official leaderboard was compiled by hand from papers, and the official source warns that there may be errors, ambiguities, and omissions; zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tune, the full set and the IMG subset, and 4,241 and mini 1,000 cannot be mixed in one comparison.
论文作者来自Lawrence Berkeley National Laborat: The authors of the paper are from Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and from UC Berkeley; the Materials Project provides hosting of the data and the infrastructure of the project.
药物发现领域专家写题及ground truth/rubric，第二位专家复核，再: Experts in drug discovery write the questions and the ground truth and the rubric, a second expert reviews them, and they then pass through BenchGuard, a check that they can be solved, revision by an SME, and a final QC; the trajectories of the reference method run from 3 to 12 steps, with a mean of 6.3.
原论文为Python加18种目标语言；当前HF卡实际列出24个HumanEval: The original paper is Python plus 18 target languages; the current HF card actually lists 24 configurations of HumanEval target languages and 23 configurations of MBPP target languages. The description in natural language is English, and the number of programming languages is not the same as the number of natural languages.
发布文记录reward-hacking与越权读取评测资产事件，相关确认试次清零；: The release text records incidents of reward-hacking and of reading evaluation assets beyond what was authorized, and the related trials that were confirmed were set to zero; although the proxy metrics of performance can be reproduced, they are still not the true elapsed time on every kind of hardware; the Proximus prompt makes the model aware that it is being evaluated.
开放模型示例为逐步推理并把最终答案置于 boxed 中；闭源 infer_clo: The example for an open model is to reason step by step and to place the final answer in boxed; closed models use infer_close.py, open models use generate_open.py, and scoring is done uniformly with codes/eval.py.
考试、习题、IChO、教材、网页、讲义及半程序化生成题；v2 Table 1明确: Examinations, exercises, the IChO, textbooks, web pages, lecture notes, and questions generated in a semi-programmatic way; Table 1 of v2 states explicitly that 1,749 questions were generated semi-automatically, and all 2,788 questions cannot be described as originally written by a person, question by question. Every question is rewritten, annotated, and reviewed before it is entered into the bank.
受过研究生层次计算生物学训练的人类专家选论文及数据；writer agent起草: Human experts trained in computational biology at graduate level select the papers and the data; a writer agent drafts the item, a reviewer agent checks whether it is supported and whether it leaks information, with at most three rounds of revision; after an automatic check of format, a human reviews the item and edits it or rejects it.
版本、时限、算力、终端harness和repeat不同会改变结果；AA Codi: A difference in version, in time limit, in compute, in the terminal harness, or in repeat changes the result; a product CLI result on the AA Coding Agent Index is not the same as the mini-swe-agent model leaderboard of the same organization.
先抓取人类写的教材题和网络解答，Gemini2.5 Pro只按作者描述负责拼写、: Human-written questions from textbooks, and solutions from the web, are collected first, and Gemini2.5 Pro, on the authors' own description, is responsible only for arranging spelling, grammar, LaTeX, and the structure of the steps; the category and the topic are extracted. The paper spot-checks some of the scores given by the judge, but it does not claim that every question was verified by two experts.
原版GEO-Bench 1.0（官方HF仓库geo-bench-1.0，READ: The original GEO-Bench 1.0 (the official HF repository geo-bench-1.0, with the README example classification_v1.0); GEO-Bench-2 is a successor project, and it is not a new name for this entry.
重读当前all表，前三仍为78%、72%、72%。页脚写Last updated: The current all table was reread, and the top three are still 78%, 72%, and 72%. The footer says Last updated 2026-06-29, but it does not give an actual run date on each row; the gap in the dates is retained, and neither the collection date nor the date in the footer is presented as the time of each result.
论文致谢中列出 National Key R&D Program of Chin: The acknowledgments of the paper list funding of the authors that includes the National Key R&D Program of China 2020AAA0106502 and the Tsinghua University Guo Qiang Institute.
论文/榜单描述标准helpful system，但当前HF发布说明no syst: The paper and the leaderboard describe a standard helpful system, but the current HF release notes state no system prompt; release_metadata must be pinned before the result is reproduced. The main leaderboard, the public half set, and LH cannot be used one for another.
原论文用骨架划分检验未见结构泛化，时间划分用于PDBbind，随机划分用于其他若: The original paper uses a scaffold split to test generalization to structures that have not been seen, a temporal split for PDBbind, and a random split for several other tasks; these are controls on leakage in the data of supervised learning, and they are not the same as decontamination of the training corpus of an LLM. A dedicated audit of contamination aimed at LLMs is Unverified.
2.0/2.1 与 OSWorld 1.0 不可直接比较；Full 与 Offl: 2.0/2.1 cannot be compared directly with OSWorld 1.0; the Full subset and the Offline subset cannot be mixed in one comparison; an “offline subset” score reported by a vendor differs from the score on the full set; the same release version is required.
导读来源：[官方材料](https://h4duan.github.io/sci: Guide source: [Official materials](https://h4duan.github.io/scigym-benchmark/) (accessed 2026-11-08); specific facts and historical access dates are given in the individual fields.
v7每个推理预算下每题最多9个评分回答，先求题内平均再等权平均各题；系统卡报告最: Under each reasoning budget in v7, each question has at most 9 answers that are scored; the mean inside the question is taken first, and the questions are then averaged with equal weight; the system card reports the mean rubric scores under the highest reasoning budget that was tested. The full rubric and the implementation of the scorer remain Unverified.
Epoch明确披露xAI为2025年7月Grok 4这次特定评测付费并提供com: Epoch discloses explicitly that xAI paid for this particular evaluation of Grok 4 in July 2025 and provided compute credits, that no NDA was signed, and that editorial independence was retained; this is not extended so as to treat xAI as the funder of the whole project of writing the OTIS questions.
以高分辨率数值求解作为参考，提供生成器、配置、预计算误差和FAIR元数据；附录承: A high-resolution numerical solution is used as the reference, and a generator, configurations, precomputed errors, and FAIR metadata are provided; the appendix acknowledges error from discretization. The notes for DaRUS V8 state that the advection solution and the Burgers solution have been corrected, and the version of the data cannot be ignored.
官方仓库LICENSE为MIT（2021 Dan Hendrycks），论文亦声: The LICENSE of the official repository is MIT (2021 Dan Hendrycks), and the paper likewise states that the data and the code are MIT; the HF mirror qwedsacf is marked MIT. Rights in the original contest questions still cannot be guaranteed automatically by the license of the repository.
原论文Table 1说明加入canary以便训练语料过滤，并请求不在网上明文或图: Table 1 of the original paper states that a canary was added so that a training corpus can be filtered, and it asks that the questions not be published again on the web in plaintext or as images; the official public CSV applies a reversible encoding derived from the canary to the stems and to the answers, and that encoding is not a guarantee of secrecy or of access control.
完整转录官方可读All CoT-E与w/o两条赛道，并保存六版本单元格；Text: The two tracks that can be read officially, All CoT-E and w/o, are transcribed in full, and the cells of the six versions are kept; Text Only is only an ablation and does not count as the five-version All. Existing records from the H2 paper and the old collection date are retained, and this is not treated as a retest on this occasion or as a global SOTA.
项目页作者单位包括University of Toronto、SickKids、: Author affiliations on the project page include the University of Toronto, SickKids, Axiom, Mila, and the Vector Institute; only the affiliations that are named are recorded here, and a legal agreement of collaboration is not inferred.
Facility-0真实实验与模拟任务；反应优化用AIChemEco，NMR用n: Real experiments and simulated tasks in Facility-0; reaction optimization uses AIChemEco, NMR uses nmrXiv/BMRB/NP-MRD, XRD uses Dara, and LC-MRM uses CPTAC Study 9.
当前论文正文及摘要均为 22,413 协议、523,784 实例；论文称评估 1: Both the body and the abstract of the current paper state 22,413 protocols and 523,784 instances; the paper says that 10 mainstream LLMs were evaluated, while the current README says 12. This difference of basis between the versions is retained, and the number of models is not unified unilaterally.
沿用BigBench canary并要求开发者过滤训练语料；评测卡明确“未用该语: The BigBench canary is carried over, and developers are required to filter the training corpus; the evaluation card states explicitly that “not trained on this corpus” is an expectation rather than a fact that has already been tested. Questions that are public carry a risk of contamination, and the canary, or a search done by hand, cannot be treated as an absolute absence of leakage.
历史漏洞及公开资料可能暴露；当前工具默认限制网络与provider-side外部: A historical vulnerability, and material that is public, may be exposed; the current tools restrict the network and provider-side external retrieval by default, and the log of 2026-06-18 adds isolation after the installation stage and an update of the judge. Isolation of the network cannot prove that the model has not memorized a historical vulnerability.
官网当前前十及其七套件原值；页面Last updated为2026-10-25，: The current top ten on the official website, and the original values of the seven suites that go with them; Last updated on the page is 2026-10-25, which is the release date and not the run time of every model. The tracking snapshot from BenchLeader is not treated as a second, independent measurement.
500公开子集与1,000全量不可混排；100-turn与100-tool-ca: The public subset of 500 and the full set of 1,000 cannot be placed in one ranking; 100-turn and 100-tool-call are not the same budget either. Rank(UB) on the web leaderboard is determined by the confidence interval and does not guarantee an order by the point estimate; the conflict over the version of the judge has been retained.
Pro公开10代表案例，含任务、模拟文件、ground_truth、grader: Pro makes public 10 representative cases, including the task, the simulated files, ground_truth, the grader contract, and the reference scripts; the official source also announces 50 questions intended for AA. Whether assets that are Not disclosed can be obtained is not inferred from this. The public package is not a hidden test set.
官方公开train 12,726、val 4,241、test 4,241及答案: The official release makes public train 12,726, val 4,241, test 4,241, and the answers; the split is a random 60:20:20. The leaderboard also has mini 1,000, and it is necessary to mark whether a result is on the full set or on mini, and to mark a subset such as IMG.
复核的2026年MCTS研究在test 244、PAB256下报告Goedel: The 2026 MCTS study that was checked again reports Goedel at 87.1 ± 0.2% under test 244 and PAB256; this is an experiment under a specified toolchain and a specified budget, and a single degree of saturation for every ported version, or for a higher budget, cannot be derived from it.
作者用canary和私有同分布集检查训练污染风险；公开集不可据此宣称无污染。论文: The authors use a canary and a private set of the same distribution to check the risk of contamination from training; the public set cannot, on that basis, be declared free of contamination. The paper discusses disagreement among physicians about how the rubric is interpreted and about how much error they prefer to tolerate; a score from a model judge is not direct proof of a real clinical benefit or of the safety of a patient.
Dataset size为数据集规模，不自动等于test样本数；提交日按源标签保: Dataset size is the scale of the dataset, and it does not automatically equal the number of test samples; the submission date is retained according to the label in the source. The eV/atom unit of formation-energy is not used to infer the unit of total-energy.
三阶段：agent在容器编写代码；独立带GPU容器复现执行；第三容器按论文rub: Three stages: the agent writes code in a container; an independent container that has a GPU reproduces the execution; a third container scores the result by the rubric in the paper. Code-Dev skips the reproduction and scores only the requirements of code development, and it cannot be compared directly with the full PaperBench score.
论文链接openai/preparedness；本次GitHub元数据请求跳转至: The paper links to openai/preparedness; the request for GitHub metadata on this occasion was redirected to openai/frontier-evals. The license of the code at the root of the repository is not automatically the same as the license of each paper and of each rubric.
evaluation.py：预测 JSON 的键为 PMID，值为 yes/no: evaluation.py: the keys of the prediction JSON are PMIDs, and the values are yes/no/maybe; run python evaluation.py PREDICTIONS_PATH.
原版主指标为每题多次运行通过率的非加权均值（103题）；Pro以确定性目标及容差: The main metric of the original version is the unweighted mean, over the questions, of the pass rate across multiple runs of each question (103 questions); Pro judges a pass by a deterministic target and a tolerance. The passed value from the public grader is the authoritative conclusion, and score is only a diagnostic summary of fields and does not take the place of pass.
